verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's docs describe its own versioning, review, and rollback for feature flags: you draft revisions, request review, require approval, publish with a commit message, and revert to a past revision. Feature rules carry the product's automated behaviors (automatic ramp-up release plans), so these controls govern the configuration that drives them. The docs never apply versioning, review, or rollback to automations specifically, and approval workflows are listed as a paid-tier feature. Missing for 10: explicit versioning, review, and rollback of automations (ramp schedules, toggle-endpoint automations) as such; config-as-code or git-based versioning; independent or hands-on corroboration of the revert flow.
